register.title: Welcome!
register.subtitle: Enter your name to get started. No account needed.

error.minLength: Name must be at least 2 characters.

action.createSessionHint: Create a new game session and invite others.
action.joinSessionHint: Join an existing session via key or QR code.

join.title: Join session
join.hint: Other players can scan this code or enter the key.

create.title: Start a Session
create.description: Create a new game session and invite your fellow players via a QR code or share link.

join.title: Join a Session
join.description: Already have a session key? Enter it here to join an existing game as a participant.

sessions.title: Your Sessions
sessions.description: All your active sessions are listed here. Tap one to jump back in — a sword icon means a battle is currently in progress.

participants.title: Participants
participants.description: Every player in this session is shown here with their civilization and government type. Your own card is highlighted with a coloured border.

army.title: Army
army.description: Opens your army view where you can produce new units. Units you have already built are listed there with their individual health and damage values.

research.title: Research
research.description: Opens the technology tree. Research techs to unlock and upgrade unit types — each discovery takes effect immediately in your army.

battle.title: Start Battle
battle.description: Initiates a combat against this player. You will be asked to set the army sizes and whether the defending city has a wall.

share.title: Invite Players
share.description: Share the join QR code or copy the link so other players can join this session.

grid.title: Your Units
grid.description: Each card represents a unit type. Unlock them by researching the matching technology. Once unlocked, tap Produce to add a new unit with randomised health and damage values.

tiers.title: Ages
tiers.description: Technologies are grouped into Ages (I–V). Jump directly to any age using these buttons. Higher ages unlock more powerful units.

toggle.title: Filter
toggle.description: Toggle this to hide already-discovered technologies and focus on what's still available.

grid.title: Technology Cards
grid.description: Each card shows the technology name, its effect on unit levels, and a Research button. Greyed-out cards have unmet prerequisites. Highlighted cards are already discovered.

banner.title: Turn Indicator
banner.description: Shows whose turn it is. When it's your turn, the banner lights up. Once all moves are done the winner is declared here.

fronts.title: Battle Fronts
fronts.description: Each front is a face-off between one of your units and one opponent unit. Health is shown as green pips — depleted units are struck through.

reserve.title: Your Reserve
reserve.description: These are your units not yet deployed. During your turn, select one and either open a new front or attack an existing one where the opponent has a unit but you don't.
